name: SiegedSec
description: SiegedSec (self-described as 'Gay Furry Hackers') was an LGBT-identified hacktivist group formed in early 2022 that conducted attacks on organizations and governments opposing LGBT rights. High-profile targets included NATO, the Idaho National Laboratory, and conservative media outlets. The group disbanded on July 10, 2024 after one of its prominent members was involved in a violent crime.
